spec.assertion: buffApply stat must be atkOfMaxHpPct (self, value 4.05, no expiry). Nearest-wrong = plain atkPct 4.05 — WRONG_S1A changes this unit's total, so the stat choice is discriminated, not merely present. Also asserts self-scope (no teammate receives it) per the HP-scaler rule that ally grants don't feed the conversion.

chargeSpeedPct value 10 with maxStacks 5, self-only, triggered per full charge. Nearest-wrong = uncapped stacks (WRONG_S1B), which changes charge cadence and therefore damage. Also asserts no emitted stack count exceeds 5.

A weaponSwap effect exists with damagePct 9.45 and maxAmmo 120, gated on max Warm Up stacks. Nearest-wrong = the swap line dropped (NO_SWAP) — moves this unit's total while leaving every teammate byte-identical (inertness assertion).

Pierce must be swap-scoped (weaponSwap.hasPierce or a gainPierce effect on the swap block), NOT the top-level hasPierce flag: the override's hasPierce is false, and WRONG_PIERCE (static flag) changes the total because it Pierce-tags pre-swap shots too.

consumeAmmo{fraction:1} on the swap-end block. NO_DUMP (line dropped) yields a strictly HIGHER total, proving the dump costs shots. Paired with a non-vacuity check that the swap actually ends at least once in the 180s fixture.
The Over Energy counter block carries swapGate:'swapped'. WRONG_S2A (gate deleted) yields a strictly higher total because the ladder climbs on base-weapon shots too; teammates stay byte-identical.

Max HP grants emit as stat maxHpFlat (caster-scaled → flat-resolved at apply) and are self-cast, which is what makes them feed skill1a's atkOfMaxHpPct conversion (caster === target). Asserts the caster on every self maxHpFlat event is this unit.

Trigger identity is the payload: stageEnter{stage:3} (fires on ANY team stage-3 entry) vs the nearest-wrong burstCast (fires only when this unit bursts). WRONG_S2C re-keys to burstCast and changes the total; faithful fire-count ≥ wrong fire-count. Non-vacuous because the fixture's fixed B3 slot supplies a second stage-3 caster. Also asserts a finite expiresFrame (10s window, not permanent).
Self atkPct 63.36 with a finite expiresFrame — discriminates a timed self buff from a permanent or team-wide one.

A burst-bucket damage event exists with fbMajorApplied false — pins the verified fact that burst-cast damage lands before Full Burst opens (no +50%). Nearest-wrong = the nuke modeled as an FB-timed rider, which would carry the major.

The rider must be gated on Over Energy stage ≥ 1 (a resourceGate). WRONG_RIDER (gate removed) yields a strictly higher total, proving the gate is load-bearing and that early bursts must not carry it. The per-stage LINEAR scaling is separately it.skip'd — see gaps.

fixtures: controlComp('laplace-ultimate-hero', true) for every run — liter B1 + crown B2 make the chain so this Burst III actually casts (a lone B3 makes ZERO full bursts, which would silently vacuum every burst/stage-3 assertion). The fixed helm B3 slot is deliberately KEPT rather than passed false: a second stage-3 caster is exactly the condition that separates stageEnter from burstCast, so it is what makes the skill2c trigger-identity assertion non-vacuous. Deterministic (no seed). 9 hoisted runs total: 1 baseline + 8 nearest-wrong counterfactuals, each an in-memory withPatchedOverride clone (committed JSON untouched).
gaps: burst rider per-stage LINEAR scaling (934.76% × stage, ×1..×4) — isolating the multiplier needs the unit to burst at a KNOWN Over Energy stage; no primitive presets the stage at cast time, so only the ≥1 gate is asserted. Needs a resource-preset test hook.
'the enemy nearest to the crosshair' — v1 has a single boss entity, so nearest-to-crosshair is indistinguishable from 'the enemy'. Unobservable payload.
Over Energy 5%-per-trigger granularity (20 twelve-attack triggers per stage) — an internal counter with no emitted event; only the resulting stage advance is observable.

swap end condition 'when all rounds are fired' (120 rounds) vs the engine's required durationSec — the swap-weapon shot economy is kit-silent on cadence, so any duration is a ⚑ estimate. FLAGGED, not asserted: pinning a derived duration would assert an invented constant.

⚑ ALWAYS-FLAG fields carried by this unit and NOT asserted: (1) the swap weapon's cadence/pullsPerSec (datamine-unreliable, kit-silent); (2) the Warm Up stack ramp — how quickly 5 stacks accrue depends on charge cadence, so any rampSec is an estimate; (3) per-kit noFb on the 934.76% rider (default OFF, measured-only).
